identities.name: U.S. Department of Energy
identities.description: The U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), through its Office of Cybersecurity, Energy Security, and Emergency Response (CESER), co-launched the Cyber-Informed Engineering (CIE) initiative to integrate cybersecurity into the design of energy infrastructure.
